title: Creamy Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
subtitle: a smooth, cozy tomato soup from pantry cans, with golden grilled cheese sandwiches for dunking
imageAlt: A bowl of creamy tomato soup beside a golden grilled cheese sandwich cut in half on a navy napkin
servingsNote: dinner for one big eater + one hungry eater, plus 2 lunches

beforeYouStart.text: Use a hand (immersion) blender if you have one; a regular blender works too, filled only halfway with the lid vented.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium and cook the onion 6–7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, sugar, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer, partly covered, 20 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Take off the heat and blend until smooth. Stir in the cream and warm through without boiling. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Build the sandwiches
steps.text: While the soup simmers, butter one side of each bread slice. Put 4 slices butter side down, cover with the cheddar and top with the other 4, butter side up.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Cook in a large skillet over medium-low 3–4 minutes a side, pressing lightly, until deep golden and the cheese has melted. Cut in half.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle the soup into bowls and serve with the grilled cheese for dunking.

fixIt.fix: Add another pinch of sugar, or a little more cream.

fixIt.problem: Grilled cheese burnt but cheese not melted
fixIt.fix: The heat was too high. Use medium-low and cover the pan for the first side.
Thin with a splash of broth or water.

saleTip: Canned tomatoes are cheapest in No Frills' no name brand, and often 10 for $10 during case-lot sales.
swap: Vegetable broth for chicken broth: same amount.
leftovers: The soup tastes even better the next day; make grilled cheese fresh.
doneness: Soup steaming hot; grilled cheese golden with fully melted cheese. Reheat soup to a simmer, 74°C (165°F).
source: Based on tested creamy tomato soup methods (Canadian Living, America's Test Kitchen): onion and garlic in butter, canned tomatoes and broth simmered, blended and finished with cream; classic skillet grilled cheese.
prepAhead: Make the soup up to 3 days ahead; add the cream when reheating.
reheat: Over medium-low, stirring, until steaming, 74°C (165°F); don't let it boil hard after the cream is in.

basic.note: Tomato soup without cream, and plain cheddar grilled cheese.

fancy.note: Grilled cheese with mozzarella and Parmesan-crusted bread.

stepNotes.3: Fancy: mix the mozzarella with the cheddar for the filling, and press the Parmesan onto the buttered outsides.

plating: Soup in a wide mug or bowl.
Grilled cheese cut in soldiers for dunking.
A swirl of cream and black pepper on the soup.

why.0-3: Good canned tomatoes beat out-of-season fresh ones for soup.
why.0-5: A little sugar rounds off the tomatoes' acidity.
why.1-2: Buttering the outside of the bread gives an even, golden crust.

funFact: Campbell's condensed tomato soup launched in 1897; grilled cheese became its partner during the Depression.

keeps.note: freeze the soup before adding the cream
